visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide shot of a railway platform sign at Yokohama station, situated under a massive arched glass and metal roof. Several commuters are standing on the platform, wearing casual summer clothing like t-shirts and shorts. Bright natural daylight fills the space, and a yellow station kiosk is visible on the far left. Large pink and white text overlays provide introductory information. (2) The scene cuts to the modern exterior of the CeeU Yokohama shopping mall under a sunset sky. The building is a high-rise with glass walls and prominent brand logos like AEON and EDION. Pedestrians are walking across a zebra crossing in the foreground. The camera then moves indoors to an AEON FOOD STYLE supermarket where a man in black is browsing shelves stocked with fresh produce and groceries. (3) The sequence transitions to the interior of a hotel room, showing a single bed with white linens and a yellow accent pillow. A wooden desk holds a television set displaying a golf match, and a window offers a view of the city. The room features a blue accent wall and simple functional furniture. The bathroom is briefly shown, containing a compact white bathtub, a pedestal sink, and a toilet against a dark tiled backsplash. (4) A night view of Yokohama harbor is presented, featuring a large neon-lit Ferris wheel and a series of pink and white fireworks exploding in the dark sky. This is followed by a shot of a pedestrian bridge at LaLaport and a street scene with a large red Torii gate. The video concludes with a green and cream Enoden train pulling into a sunlit station as passengers wait on the platform.
